name: public_appointment_booking
description: Reference plugin for unauthenticated (public) appointment booking. A public page lists open slots and accepts booking requests, with rate limits, an origin check, strict input validation and no patient data in any response. Off until PUBLIC_BOOKING_ENABLED is set to true.

handlers.description: Public routes under /public: GET /book (page), GET /slots (open slots), POST /book (booking request). All return 404 unless PUBLIC_BOOKING_ENABLED=true.
